source: Reading for Mike — August 29 2026 (Svehla). Dates verbatim from the reading's chronological list; the Jupiter 2H second pass uses the body-text end date (Oct 16 2027) which the ephemeris confirms over the list's Oct 5.

windows.title: Transiting Juno pushing on your Descendant
windows.why: Loyalty and equal sharing are your Juno themes (11° Cancer, 12th). Tension with your partner simmers while Juno sits on the 7th-house angle; Saturn is also squaring natal Juno, so work stress leaks into home.
windows.do: Iron out boundaries now: how her kids get disciplined, who carries which chores, and the emotional load split. Say it out loud before Oct 7.

windows.title: Transiting Saturn pushing on your Midheaven
windows.why: The single reason you booked this reading, per Svehla. Saturn = increasing limits, repeated lessons, real growth. Natal Mars square transiting Saturn is his 'Square of Hercules': personal will vs authority makes epic accomplishments possible.
windows.do: Settle every loose end in your career as soon as you can. Two paths he named: entrepreneurship (Aries MC, needs Saturn-grade self-discipline) or a healthcare system / insurance-accepting employer. Mars rules your MC: take action.

windows.title: Progressed Moon at the critical degrees 21-22° Taurus
windows.why: Emotionally demanding, not a crisis. Forces a closer look at how you view earnings, assets, and material security. Progressed Moon is in your 10th and enters your 11th (income from vocation, Uranus' house) within three months.
windows.do: Do the money evaluation on purpose instead of being dragged through it: what brings security, what you earn, what you own.

windows.title: Transiting Jupiter in your natal 2nd house (first pass)
windows.why: Jupiter complements Saturn if you persistently strive to meet objectives. 'Controlled expansion': grow income while securely managing resources.
windows.do: Expand your material security and income as much as you can during these dates. This is the harvest window the Feb reading also pointed at.

windows.title: Transiting Juno enters Aquarius, stops opposing natal Mars
windows.why: Svehla's guess: the relationship feels less heavy from this day, especially if you ironed things out during the Juno-on-Descendant window.
windows.do: Notice the shift. If the tension lifted, credit the boundary work, not luck.

windows.title: Progressed Moon 28-29° Taurus conjunct fixed star Alcyone
windows.why: The window Svehla is most concerned about. Not fate, but the possibility of losses, lower income, or a forced move. Progressed Moon enters Gemini May 3 2027 and the pressure lifts.
windows.do: Prepare now, six months out: contingency plans for housing and income stability. Guard against stagnating income and stay afloat through Q1 2027. Have the housing situation as set as possible so you don't have to move unless you choose to.

windows.title: Transiting Saturn opposite natal Apollon
windows.why: Supercharges the 'plant seeds now' theme. Saturn is also opposite natal Jupiter through this stretch.
windows.do: Whatever career seeds you planted in the fall, tend them hard in this fortnight.

windows.title: Progressed Moon and progressed Venus both at the anaretic 29th degree
windows.why: Peak of the career-and-earnings change theme. Moon at 29° Taurus (possessions), Venus at 29° Capricorn (career/structure). Early June 2027 repeats the March theme.
windows.do: Expect the change to crest here. Decisions about work and money made in April 2027 set the next chapter.

windows.title: Transiting Saturn in your natal 10th house (mostly)
windows.why: Saturn at the apex of your natal promise, squaring natal Mars, sitting at the focal point of a t-square with Uranus and Neptune at the base. Saturn there says: minimize risk, identify problems strategically, confront or avoid them.
windows.do: Build the foundation. Hard work, patience, discipline, structure. Two years of Saturn in the 10th is the framework of your next decade.

windows.title: Transiting Jupiter in your natal 2nd house (second pass)
windows.why: Same controlled-expansion theme, second chance after the retrograde.
windows.do: Second income push. Whatever worked Oct 2026 to Feb 2027, do it again bigger.

windows.title: Progressed Venus enters Aquarius
windows.why: Venus leaves the restricted, edgy end of Capricorn. Aquarius Venus: partner as friend, freedom inside structure, and oddly more wanted alone time. She immediately squares natal Sun (a benefic square bestows benefits) and conjuncts natal Saturn by sign: partnerships become critically important and potentially lucrative. Raises relationship questions and a possible move; not divorce.
windows.do: Be prepared for new experiences and thoughts about relationships. Have money saved and a plan so a move is bearable if it comes. Many years of this Venus ahead.

windows.title: Transiting Uranus conjunct natal Hades (pass 1 of 3)
windows.why: Caution: a sudden financial shift backwards is possible. Impulsivity or outside pressure encourages a bad financial decision. Also: epiphanies about your past, catharsis, examining causality.
windows.do: Be thorough and cautious with finances. No impulsive money moves. Use the insight side: what can you eliminate to get a fresh start?

windows.title: Transiting Uranus conjunct natal Hades (pass 2 of 3)
windows.why: Same as pass 1. Svehla is looking for a breakthrough somehow for you in 2028-2029.
windows.do: Conservative finances. Research what interests you about your own current state of life; it can be highly revealing.

windows.title: Jupiter return (Jupiter enters Libra)
windows.why: Start of a new 12-year growth cycle in your 3rd house of communication.
windows.do: Mark it. What you begin here compounds.

windows.title: Transiting Uranus conjunct natal Hades (pass 3 of 3)
windows.why: Final pass. Keep what is working, pare what is not.
windows.do: Last cautious-finance window of the trio. Then the rearrangement is done.

windows.title: Transiting Chiron exactly opposite natal Sun (1 of 3)
windows.why: Chiron opposes your Sun by wide orb from April 2027 to July 2031. The exact hits deal with financial security and examining your own ego in how you relate to others. Not predicting strife, but know your relationship vulnerabilities.
windows.do: Be open-minded. The gift in the wound: learn more about yourself and move beyond old woundedness. Strengthens the relationship if you do the work.

windows.title: Progressed Venus exactly conjunct natal Ceres
windows.why: Self care, or seeking care from someone brilliant in their field. Fair compensation for what you're paid to do. Ending difficult cycles, a renewed fresh approach.
windows.do: Ask for what you're worth. Get the care you need from the best person you can find.

windows.title: Transiting Chiron exactly opposite natal Sun (2 of 3)
windows.why: Second exact hit. Same themes: financial security, ego, relating.
windows.do: Same as the first pass. Stay open.

windows.title: Transiting Chiron exactly opposite natal Sun (3 of 3)
windows.why: Final exact hit. The 2029-2030 Chiron experience prepares you for your Chiron return about seventeen years out.
windows.do: Close the loop on what the first two passes opened.

windows.title: Chiron three-quarter return (mid to late 2031)
windows.why: You might feel some effects. Svehla's own Chiron return bordered on the profound and mirrored his natal Chiron house (yours: Leo, 2nd house, the self-worth and money wound).
windows.do: Watch how money and self-worth get tangled that year. That's the wound doing its work.
